questions.question: In economics, "Giffen Goods" are a unique type of inferior good for which the demand rises as the price rises. This is because of which reason?

In economics, "Giffen Goods" are a unique type of inferior good for which the demand rises as the price rises.

This is because of which reason?

options.text: The substitution effect outweighs the income effect.
options.html: The substitution effect outweighs the income effect.

options.text: The income effect outweighs the substitution effect.
options.html: The income effect outweighs the substitution effect.

options.text: There are too many close substitutes available.
options.html: There are too many close substitutes available.

options.text: They are considered luxury items by the elite class.
options.html: They are considered luxury items by the elite class.

questions.solution:
Correct Answer: The income effect outweighs the substitution effect ✅

Explanation:

Giffen Goods are a rare type of inferior good where an increase in price leads to an increase in demand.

This happens because the negative income effect (reduction in real income) is stronger than the substitution effect, forcing consumers to buy more of the cheaper staple (the Giffen good) despite the price rise.

Other options:

The substitution effect outweighs the income effect — would lead to normal downward-sloping demand.

Too many close substitutes available — not relevant for Giffen goods.

Considered luxury items by the elite — incorrect, Giffen goods are basic staples for low-income consumers.

questions.solution:
Correct Answer: Lactic Acid ✅

Explanation:

During vigorous exercise, when oxygen supply is insufficient, muscles perform anaerobic respiration.

This converts glucose into lactic acid, which accumulates in muscles, causing fatigue and cramps.

Other options:

Pyruvic Acid — intermediate in glycolysis, not the main cause of cramps.

Folic Acid — vitamin B₉, unrelated to muscle fatigue.

Acetic Acid — vinegar component, not produced in muscles.

= 2[(a² + b² + c²) − (ab + bc + ca)]

Now find the value of ab+bc+ca

= (144 − 56)/2 = 44

Value = 2(56 − 44) = 24
